The *Kusalattika, Kilesagocchaka* (Patthana 4.6) constitutes a section of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the concluding book of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. As indicated by its title, the text examines conditional relations by combining the triad of wholesome phenomena (*kusalattika*) with the cluster of defilements (*kilesagocchaka*), systematically exploring their mutual conditioning in accordance with Abhidhamma relational methodology [SuttaCentral].
